main.description: Get the requester's membership of this AppView, and the features it serves. Requires auth. An eligible requester (an active account on a community PDS this AppView serves, while it has room) is enrolled by this call, as by loading the timeline, whether or not this AppView indexes public data. The answer concerns only the requester.

validForSecs.description: How long the client may act on this answer, in seconds, counted from when it received it (never compared with the device clock). 'member': this AppView's setting, an hour by default; 'indexing': the Retry-After value, so the client polls as before; 'notEligible': no longer than a refusal is remembered. Ask again at once after NotEnrolled or NotReady from any private or Thread Lens read, a 401 a fresh token does not cure, a 501 on a method features said was served, an account switch or sign-in. Private reads are authorized on every request whatever this says. The response carries Cache-Control: private, no-store; the validity is this field, never an HTTP cache. Present in every answer of this version.

permissions.description: This AppView's answer for the requester, so a client need not derive it from status and features. Present in every answer of this version.

status.description: 'member': a ready member; the private read methods serve the requester. 'indexing': enrolled, and the account's initial indexing is still running; the response carries a Retry-After header, a polling hint rather than an estimate. 'notEligible': not enrolled now. It means "not now", not "never": a refusal is remembered for up to an hour (for example while the requester's PDS is unreachable, or while this AppView is full), and the requester may ask again on a later session. reindexing: a member being re-indexed after an interruption; permissions as for member, and private reads answer Reindexing until it ends (validForSecs and Retry-After are the retry interval).

features.description: The feature families this AppView serves, whatever the requester's status, read when the call is answered, so a change of this AppView's settings shows on the next call. The private-tier values ('private' and 'private.*') are present only while the private tier is enabled. Known values: 'threadLens' (app.nearhorizon.threadLens.getThread and resolve are served; listed whether or not the AppView can bridge, which each Thread Lens response reports in its own 'bridging'); 'threadLens.signedIn' (listed with 'threadLens' when Thread Lens serves every signed-in account, a requester that is not a ready member with viewer.blockedBy and viewer.muted false only; without it Thread Lens serves ready members only and refuses anyone else NotEnrolled or NotReady); 'private' (the app.nearhorizon.private read methods); 'private.embeds' (facets, embeds, langs, labels and audience on private post views); 'private.bookmarks' (the app.nearhorizon.private bookmark methods and viewer.bookmarked); 'private.gates' (threadgates and postgates on private posts: threadgate on a thread root, viewer.replyDisabled, hidden replies, viewer.embeddingDisabled and detached quotes); 'private.interactions' (counts and viewer state on private post views, getLikes, getRepostedBy, getQuotes, repost items and thread mutes of private roots); 'private.notifications' (the app.nearhorizon.private notification methods: listNotifications, getUnreadCount, updateSeen); 'private.freshIndex' (app.nearhorizon.index.requestRecord answers caughtUp, and with caughtUp true the caller's private posts read at once); 'private.paging' (sealed cursors on getAuthorFeed, getTimeline and getReplies that page past posts the requester cannot read, so a short or empty page can carry a cursor; the filter parameter of getAuthorFeed; app.nearhorizon.private.getReplies); 'private.crossPdsReplies' (replies under another account's audience are served when anchored to that account's post in the thread, on any PDS); 'private.following' (the `following` audience mode: read by the accounts its owner follows, once the AppView has compared those follows with the owner's repository); 'private.search' (app.nearhorizon.private.searchPosts, a scan at query time over the recent private posts the requester may read); 'private.threadAudience' (a reply is read by its thread root's current audience, or its branch root's in a private branch under a public post, while its writer and every writer above it stand under that audience; chains are walked up to this AppView's max_chain posts; a paged read reads at most twice its limit, so a short page can carry a cursor); 'private.mediaFilters' (posts_with_media and posts_with_video on getAuthorFeed); 'private.notificationPreferences' (app.nearhorizon.private.getNotificationPreferences and putNotificationPreferences; listNotifications and getUnreadCount honour them); 'private.anyPds' (private posts from any PDS are served, and a private post without encodedContent is served to no reader, its author included: encode in the client); 'private.unreadReasons' (app.nearhorizon.private.getUnreadCount takes reasons, applied as listNotifications applies them); 'private.replyContext' (getTimeline and getAuthorFeed items that are replies carry reply, their root and parent, private ones read for the requester); 'private.notificationSubjects' (listNotifications items carry reasonSubjectPost, the private post reasonSubject names, read for the requester); 'private.notServed' (the author's own private post views carry notServed when this AppView would not serve the post to any reader of its audience, with the post-level reasons; absent means served); 'private.degraded' (while this AppView is degraded, a private relay behind, the listed private read responses carry degraded and retryAfter, and every response carries unavailable naming the requester's own posts it could not serve yet; getPostThread answers 503 Unavailable with retryAfter in the body, and a quoted private post it cannot show is app.nearhorizon.private.defs#viewUnavailable); 'private.reindexing' (a member whose indexing was interrupted after it was first ready answers status 'reindexing', and the private read methods, Thread Lens and member-only methods answer 503 Reindexing with retryAfter in the body instead of NotReady, until it ends). Later values name further families; a client ignores values it does not know.

errors.name: RateLimitExceeded
errors.description: This AppView's hourly enrolment limit is reached. The response carries Retry-After; ask again after it.

privateRead.description: The private read methods serve the requester now: a ready member, while the private tier is enabled.

privateIndexed.description: Private posts the requester writes are indexed by this AppView and served once its indexing is ready: a member, ready or not, while the private tier is enabled. When false, do not offer private posting against this AppView: such posts would be written and never served. It does not say every record is served: while features lists 'private.anyPds', a post without encodedContent is served to no reader, its author included, so the client encodes its private posts.

threadLens.description: Thread Lens serves the requester: a ready member, or any signed-in account while features lists 'threadLens.signedIn'.
